title: Sir Bors
summary: Sir Bors was one of the Knights of the Round Table. He later undertook the quest for the Holy Grail in which he succeeded alongside Sir Galahad and Sir Percival. He was renowned for being a hard worker and, on his quest, he achieved what the powerful Sir Lancelot could not.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
In ancient times, Sir Bors served [[King Arthur]] as one of his most trusted [[Knights of the Round Table]]. He later undertook the quest for the [[Holy Grail]] and succeeded along with two other knights, [[Sir Galahad]] and [[Sir Percival]]. {{source|Memory Lane}} A statue was built in honor of him and the other two knights alongside that of [[Sir Lancelot]] inside his [[Mausoleum of Sir Lancelot|Mausoleum]]. {{source|Memory Lane}}

Many years later, [[Lok Lambert]] and [[Dante Vale]] observed Bors' statue and found that his sword pointed to a switch in the wall that opened the secret passage to Lancelot's hidden sanctuary. {{source|Memory Lane}}
